description: This file is a shell script used for testing the integration and configuration of 'git svn' with auto-props functionality. It defines functions for generating auto-props configurations, initializes a git-svn repository, enables/disables auto-props, adds files to verify property settings, and checks the properties and renaming behavior within the SVN repository.

methods.name: generate_auto_props
methods.description: Creates an auto-props configuration string based on whether auto-props should be enabled or not.
